summary: Kalyani Steels Limited has initiated a postal ballot to appoint Mr. Ajay Kirtane as an independent director for a five-year term. Shareholders can vote electronically via NSDL from September 19 to October 18, 2026.

headline: NIIT Ltd partners with SPJIMR for FinTech certificate
summary: NIIT Limited and SPJIMR launch a Professional Certificate in FinTech Operations to build talent for India's digital finance ecosystem, focusing on non-coding roles.

headline: Tipco Engineering enters defence sector with new subsidiary
summary: Tipco Engineering India Ltd incorporates TIPCO Defence Technologies & Robotics Pvt Ltd, taking a 51% stake. The subsidiary will focus on defence equipment and robotics systems.

headline: ABFRL incorporates UAE subsidiary for Sabyasachi retail expansion
summary: Aditya Birla Fashion & Retail Limited's subsidiary Sabyasachi India Limited has incorporated Sabyasachi Retail FZ-LLC in the UAE. The entity aims to deal in designer apparel and jewellery in Ras Al Khaimah.

headline: Puravankara secures ₹2,600 crore Mumbai redevelopment deal
summary: Puravankara has secured a redevelopment project worth ₹2,600 crore in Goregaon West, Mumbai, marking a significant addition to its real estate portfolio in the city.

headline: Softtech Engineers wins ₹92.95 crore JNPA project
summary: Softtech Engineers secures a ₹92.95 crore AI-enabled Digital Twin and Command & Control Centre project from JNPA, marking its first win in the port sector.

headline: Puravankara wins Rs 2600 crore redevelopment order in Mumbai
summary: Puravankara secured a Rs 2600 crore redevelopment rights order from residential societies in Mumbai. The deal covers 4.68 acres with 1.05 million sq ft potential, marking a significant expansion in the company's order book.

headline: Gre Renew Enertech wins Rs 25.56 cr solar EPC order
summary: Gre Renew Enertech secured a Rs 25.56 crore ground-mounted solar EPC order from an undisclosed domestic client. The deal covers 7 projects ranging from 600 kW to 1500 kW AC capacity.

headline: Stanbik Agro AGM: Resolutions passed unanimously
summary: Stanbik Agro Limited shareholders approved all four resolutions at the 5th AGM held on September 15, 2026. The special resolution appointed Anil Kumar Vijayvargia as independent director.

headline: Sanwaria Consumer posts FY26 loss under CIRP
summary: Sanwaria Consumer Limited reported a standalone net loss of ₹281.53 lakh for FY26, a slight improvement from the previous year's loss of ₹292.31 lakh. The company remains under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) with no manufacturing activity.

headline: RRP Electronics gets ROC nod for AGM extension
summary: The Registrar of Companies has granted RRP Electronics India Limited a three-month extension to hold its 68th AGM. The new deadline is December 31, 2026, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

headline: NHC Foods sets up US subsidiary for trading
summary: NHC Foods Ltd has incorporated Conquer Enterprises LLC in Wyoming, US, as a foreign subsidiary through its step-down subsidiary. The entity aims to enhance global business operations.

headline: Prestige Estates launches Garden Breeze project
summary: Prestige Estates Projects launches Garden Breeze in Sarjapur, Bengaluru. The 10-acre development features 655 apartments with a GDV of ₹1100 crore.

headline: Privi Speciality Chemicals to host investor meet on Sep 22
summary: Privi Speciality Chemicals Limited will hold an investor conference in Mumbai on September 22, 2026, organized by Anand Rathi Institutional Equities. The meeting will cover publicly available information only.

headline: Priority Jewels wins tax appeal, drops penalty
summary: Priority Jewels Ltd received a favourable appellate order for AY 2011-12, deleting tax additions and dropping penalty proceedings. The company expects a reduction in tax demand of ₹3.54 crore.

headline: Tata Sons said to reappoint N Chandrasekaran as chairman
summary: Tata Sons is reportedly set to reappoint N Chandrasekaran as chairman, according to television reports. The development signals continuity at the helm of the Tata Group holding company.

headline: Aptus Pharma to host investor meet on Sep 25
summary: Aptus Pharma Limited announced a virtual investor interaction scheduled for September 25, 2026. The management will participate in the Arihant Capital Bharat Connect conference.

headline: Cinevista to write off investments in 3 dormant subsidiaries
summary: Cinevista Ltd board meeting on Sept 22, 2026 considers 100% provision for loans and equity in three non-operational subsidiaries. The move aims to clean up the balance sheet after a decade of inactivity.

headline: Tata Sons board agrees to comply with RBI IPO mandate
summary: Tata Sons board has agreed to take all steps necessary to go public as required by the RBI, a development that also involves Tata Chemicals and Tata Investment Corp.

headline: OM Power Transmission wins ₹40.69 crore NTPC contract
summary: OM Power Transmission secured a ₹40.69 crore contract from HILD Projects for a 220KV switchyard at an NTPC solar plant, to be completed in 10 months.

headline: HB Portfolio withholds dividend for incomplete KYC
summary: HB Portfolio Limited has withheld the interim dividend payment for FY27 for shareholders with incomplete KYC details. The payout of ₹1.25 per share was declared in August 2026.

headline: Qualitek Labs to consider fund raising on Sep 22
summary: Qualitek Labs Limited has scheduled a board meeting for September 22, 2026, to deliberate on potential fund-raising measures. The proposal may include equity shares or convertible securities via rights issue or private placement.

headline: Om Power Transmission wins Rs 40.69 crore order from Hild Projects
summary: Om Power Transmission secured a Rs 40.69 crore order from Hild Projects Private Limited for a 220kV AIS Switchyard project. The deal adds to the company's recent wins from state utilities and private clients.

headline: Apex Frozen Foods declares ₹2.50 dividend
summary: Apex Frozen Foods Limited declared a final dividend of ₹2.50 per share for FY26 at its 14th AGM. The company also reappointed its Executive Chairman.

headline: Tata Elxsi to host analyst meet on Sep 22
summary: Tata Elxsi Limited will participate in the J.P. Morgan India Conference in Mumbai on September 22, 2026. The physical group meeting is scheduled under SEBI Regulation 30.

headline: Jana SFB re-appoints K S Raman as ED
summary: Jana Small Finance Bank re-appoints K S Raman as Executive Director for three years starting Jan 1, 2027, following RBI approval.
